title: Initial project setup - AETHER fork from Agave
body:
## Summary

This PR sets up the initial project structure for the AETHER blockchain fork from Agave (Solana's Rust core).

## Changes

- Created 5-layer modular architecture:
  - `aether-core`: Core types and primitives
  - `aether-consensus`: PoH + PoS hybrid consensus
  - `aether-poh`: Proof of History implementation
  - `aether-ai-lanes`: AI-powered transaction priority
  - `aether-network`: P2P networking layer
  - `aether-storage`: Blockchain storage

- Added comprehensive README with build instructions
- Added LICENSE (Apache 2.0)
- Added .gitignore for Rust project

## Architecture

AETHER implements a 5-layer architecture for scalability and maintainability.

## Testing

- [ ] `cargo build` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] Documentation builds

## Related Issues

Closes #11
